title: Lender statement row
description: One payment as the lender's monthly statement reports it. Copy these figures from the payment, not the year-to-date column.

Statement date.description: Date the lender applied the payment.

Payment received.description: What the lender received. Matches the withdrawal on the bank statement.

Fees.description: Late or other fees in this payment. Blank means 0.00.

Principal balance after.description: What the loan payable account in the books should show on the same date.
